site.title: Maciej Lewandowski - Senior Blockchain Engineer
site.description: Field notes and consulting for digital asset custody, wallet infrastructure and tokenization.
site.feedDescription: Field notes from custody and wallet infrastructure: Bitcoin, EVM, Solana, and the backend systems that hold real money.

posts.title: Money in Rust: Making Illegal States Unrepresentable
posts.description: Newtypes, phantom-typed currencies, checked arithmetic and typestate - how much of a financial bug class the compiler can take off your hands, for zero bytes.

posts.title: Your Backtest Is Lying to You
posts.description: Look-ahead bias, survivorship, point-in-time data and overfitting - why a backtest is a replay engine, and what that demands of it.

posts.title: Why Your Deposit Detection Misses Money
posts.description: Proxy contracts, fee-on-transfer tokens, reorgs, UTXO edge cases and Solana token accounts - and why continuous reconciliation is the only real fix.

posts.title: Transaction State Machines for Multi-Chain Custody
posts.description: Broadcast is not done, confirmed is not final, and retries are where money gets lost. What breaks, chain by chain.

posts.title: UTXO Coin Selection in Production
posts.description: Your Bitcoin balance is not a number, it is a set. Fees, dust, privacy and the concurrency problem the tutorials skip.

posts.title: Stuck Transactions at Scale
posts.description: RBF, CPFP, nonce queues, expiring blockhashes and the pinning problem - a remediation playbook for transactions that will not confirm.

posts.title: The Rules for Agent-Written Code in a Regulated Codebase Just Changed
posts.description: A practical reading of AI-assisted engineering obligations and evidence expectations in regulated software delivery.

posts.title: AI Coding Agents in Production: What Actually Changes
posts.description: A field-tested operating model for using AI coding agents in production: context, task decomposition, review, guardrails and the real verification cost.

posts.title: You Are Overfitting Your Training the Same Way You Overfit a Backtest
posts.description: Why short training logs are noisy time series, and how to distinguish adherence from meaningful signal.

posts.title: Upgradeable Tokens: Where Do the Balances Actually Live?
posts.description: Delegatecall, proxy storage and the custody consequences of upgradeable token architecture.

posts.title: A Multisig Nobody Can See
posts.description: Taproot, MuSig2 and the operational trade-offs between privacy, cost and auditability in custody.

posts.title: Balance at 14:00 UTC Does Not Exist
posts.description: Chains never close, so a point-in-time balance has to be derived, not queried. The anchor problem, the per-chain traps, and why reproducibility is the real requirement.

posts.title: SIGHASH Is a Security Parameter, Not a Construction Detail
posts.description: Why Bitcoin signature hash modes belong in custody policy rather than transaction plumbing.
